name: tinymusic-agent-skills
description: TinyMusic agent skills for songs, lyrics, gift songs, jingles and background music. Free to use without any setup; an optional MCP server lets the agent generate audio directly.

plugins.name: ai-song-generator
plugins.description: Turn an idea or finished lyrics into a complete song. Standalone it prepares a paste-ready generation pack for the TinyMusic generator; with the optional MCP it generates the song.

plugins.name: lyrics-writer
plugins.description: Write, rewrite or polish song lyrics in any language, with a paste-ready package for the TinyMusic generator.

plugins.name: music-style-prompt-guide
plugins.description: Guide to writing effective AI music prompts and style strings: genre, mood, tempo, instruments, vocals and production feel, with examples and templates.

plugins.name: royalty-free-bgm
plugins.description: Instrumental background music briefs for videos, podcasts, games and streams, with prompt recipes for mood, energy and loop feel. Makes no licensing claims.

plugins.name: personalized-song-gift
plugins.description: Personalized gift songs for birthdays, weddings, anniversaries and more, built from an interview about real details, with lyrics and a style ready to generate.

plugins.name: brand-jingle-creator
plugins.description: Short brand jingles, sonic logos and intro/outro music: a brief becomes three distinct directions and a paste-ready pack.
